observations.distance: Close range during the strike, then opening slightly as they reset.
observations.notable: A continuous combination pattern is visible, ending with both fighters in a neutral standoff.

movement_events.detail: The striker on the right steps forward to close the distance.
Striker throws a lead-hand jab.
Striker throws a rear-hand cross.
Striker retracts the punch and resets to a defensive/ready position.
Striker throws a left hook, continuing the combination.
Both fighters return to a neutral stance, ending the exchange.
